chapter: Los Angeles with Mutt Carey and the taxi dances
title: Who else was in Mutt's band
summary: Joe lists Ram Hall, L.Z. Cooper, Alex Hill, trombonists Leon White and Parker Berry, and tenors Big Boy Williams and Charlie Mosely, with himself on alto.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And Ram [Hall] was on the drums with that band?
Yeah, Ram was on drums. L.Z. Cooper played piano.
They alternated? You say Alex Hill was in the band after...

Alex Hill was in the band after... Let me get this straight. L.Z. Cooper was in the band first, and then Mutt fired him or something, for some reason got rid of him, and then Alex Hill came in the band. Then we had a trombone player in the band, too, named Leon White, and then he left the band, and then we got a guy named Parker Berry, who was a very good trombone player.
So it was six pieces, in other words.
What was the other piece? Saxophone?
The other piece was a tenor sax, a guy named Big Boy Williams played tenor.
I think we covered a little of him...
Well, we had two tenors while I was in the band. Charlie Mosely played tenor with us for a while, which was a good tenor man from Wilmington, Delaware.
What did you play, alto or clarinet?
I played alto. I played alto, and I still didn't play clarinet; I doubled on soprano. And sometimes I played a baritone.
